::: {#exm-excluded-middle}
#### A tautology and a contradiction

| $P$ | $\neg P$ | $P \lor \neg P$ | $P \land \neg P$ |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| T | F | T | F |
| F | T | T | F |

$P \lor \neg P$ is a tautology (@def-tautology),
and $P \land \neg P$ is a contradiction (@def-contradiction).

:::
